claim_rule: Only true capabilities may be described as established. A Holodeck world, entity, event, narrative, consensus, role, capability, or simulated action is synthetic state only and cannot create Federation authority, trust, evidence, citizenship, network access, tool access, credentials, or real WorldStore mutation.

promotion_requirements.production_networking: requires a later production deployment profile with mature operational hardening and deployment evidence
promotion_requirements.remote_execution: not admitted by the current constitutional posture; Holodeck simulated execution is explicitly not real execution
